added: Dashboard: a card for every session you drive, recorded while the app runs, with the circuit, the car, your laps and times, your place and the gap to the session best
Sector Time widget: purple for a session best sector, green for your own best, yellow for the rest, with an option to show the sectors as running totals
Cuts widget: track limit points spent out of those allowed, and an infinity sign where nothing is policed
Boxes (P91 Logo) style for the RPM Panel, every readout in a coloured frame of its own
P91 Team theme, with the team mark in the title bar and a photograph under the window
Black to Green background for the Inputs widget and the RPM Panel
Presets can be exported to a file and imported back, and an imported preset never overwrites your own
Disable all and Enable all, for every widget at once
fixed: A session is now finished when you leave it for the menus, not only when the game closes
The app went on saying Connected after the game had exited
An out lap ran a clock and showed INVALID as though it were a timed lap
The lap time after joining a session showed the age of the session instead of the lap
Sectors 2 and 3 were measured against themselves, and the best sectors started every session blank
A driver who left the session took their sector times with them
Aero damage was read on the wrong scale, so a hit to the nose lit the rear wing
Disable all could not see Sector Time or Cuts, and Enable all restored the previous set instead of every widget
